Usage: gaia search lkm nodes [OPTIONS] [IDS]...

 Batch-fetch LKM node record detail.

 POST /variables/batch.

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   ids      [IDS]...  LKM node ids to fetch (variadic).                       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --index,--server        TEXT  Configured LKM index id. [default: bohrium]    │
│ --ids-file              PATH  Newline-delimited ids to merge with positional │
│                               ids.                                           │
│ --out                   PATH  Write JSON to PATH (atomic) instead of stdout. │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 Examples:
 gaia search lkm nodes gcn_...
 gaia search lkm nodes --ids-file ids.txt
 What you have:
 one or more global gcn_... / node ids  ->  nodes
 a file-local paper:N::P1 id            ->  not this command
 a research question                    ->  knowledge / reasoning
 Use this for follow-up inspection when a search or reasoning response prints
 specific LKM node ids. Partial misses are returned in `not_found` and do not
 make the whole response fail.
 API docs:
 https://s.apifox.cn/<UUID4>/api-459805971
 Endpoint links: gaia search lkm docs
